6 ##* (RQ:Besant Ivory Gate II passage=At twilight in the summer there is never anybody to fear—man, woman, or '''cat'''—in the chambers and at that hour the mice come out. They do not eat parchment or foolscap or red tape, but they eat the luncheon crumbs.)

You eat '''cat''' because cats have a lively ''jingshen'', or spirit, and thus by eating the animal you will improve your spirits.)
11 ###* (quote-book en author=w:James Bartleman title=The Redemption of Oscar Wolf publisher=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dundurn%20Press year=2013 isbn=978-1-4597-0984-3 passage=I ate at a Chinese restaurant once, even though my friends told me I would probably be eating '''cat''' and dog disguised as chicken.)
12 ## Any similar, chiefly nondomesticated, animal of the family (taxfmt Felidae family), which includes bobcats, caracals, cheetahs, cougars, leopards, lion#Noun, lynxes, tigers, and other such species.
13 ##* (quote-book en year=1977 author=Peter Hathaway Capstick title=Death in the Long Grass: A Big Game Hunter's Adventures in the African Bush publisher=St. Martin's Press page=44 passage=I grabbed it and ran over to the lion from behind, the '''cat''' still chewing thoughtfully on Silent's arm.)
